turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so you have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that, and when.
I didn't come for thanks. Who entered that zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?
We're not here about the weather, Hale. I'm writing down that you've had two chances to tell me who decided this and you've talked about hockey.
What do you do for fun?
Owen. That's who I'm here about, and if you won't talk about him, I'm walking down to the principal's office right now.
